meta.what: Blind predictions of the g13 twist repeats of the night of 2026-11-17 (corvus), committed before they ran, from the re-planned open pose (start 'replan' = plans/20261117-film_x105_y70_twist_gr_g13_replan_plan.json) and from the mcpstop pose (plans/20261117-film_x105_y70_twist_gr_g13_mcpstop_plan.json). Plant: rev_clutch2's gears (forward friction 0.6 |tau|, no backdrive), index and middle yaw gains 0.35 (x1.5 at 7.5 V), plant gain 0.55 and torque limit 0.18 N m at 5 V, x1.5 at 7.5 V (the voltage scaling is assumed, not measured: S3 measures it); HOM converts at 0.55 under the bench's budget 0.56; the stem scene; contact models: pads with soft tangential contact (impratio 1), point contact soft, pads stiff (impratio 100); the hand's MCP stops (-11.4, -10.0 deg) in the plant; contacts to HOM off (as --tips off) or exact (the bench's --tips on streams estimates). Seeds 0-2. Metrics: track = 1 - err/ref from 2.0 s (hom_tasks.metrics); twist at the end about z_P; drift = largest distance of the sphere from its first pose; rise = largest rise.
